notes.title: Halloween is Here! Slashy Hero Launches Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355201/18c5b9d4d4e972f68ab5618fd09b8a5b0de5aeec.png[/img]

Halloween is nearly upon us! Gear up and get ready for the cutest and wildest dungeon crawler this Halloween! 

Join the Slashy Hero as you fight your way through 96 levels of monsters and ghouls, utilizing a unique drawing mechanic to vanquish your foes! And if that's not enough, we also have two other modes and one of them has an additional 200 levels!

Collect hundreds of costumes along the way as you dress up to be the hero you want to be! Want to be a magic wielding dinosaur, or a gun-toting ninja? It's all here, and only limited by your imagination(and the costumes we give you obviously)!

Did we mention the game has also won a ton of awards, been nominated at Tokyo Game Show for Best Indie Game, and has been hailed as the best game ever made (by our designer)?

Your Halloween would not be complete without this!
